title: A Guide to Google Ads for Restaurant Owners in 2025

facts.fact: The guide recommends daily Google Ads spend of £5–£10 per day for small restaurants.
facts.quote: Small restaurants:** Start with £5–£10 per day.

facts.fact: The guide recommends daily Google Ads spend of £20–£50 per day for mid-sized restaurants in higher competition areas.
facts.quote: Mid-sized restaurants:** £20–£50 per day for higher competition areas.

facts.fact: The guide suggests daily Google Ads spend of £100+ per day for large restaurants or chains pursuing aggressive marketing.
facts.quote: Large restaurants or chains:**£100+ per day for aggressive marketing.

facts.fact: The guide describes Google Ads as a pay-per-click model in which advertisers pay only when someone clicks on the ad.
facts.quote: Google Ads works on a pay-per-click (PPC) model, meaning you only pay when someone clicks on your ad.

facts.fact: The guide states Google often has a promotion to match early ad spend for new advertisers.
facts.quote: Google often has a promo to match your early ad spend.

facts.fact: The guide states that Performance Max campaigns automatically show ads across Google Search, Maps, YouTube, and Gmail.
facts.quote: automatically shows your ads across multiple platforms, including Google Search, Maps, YouTube, and Gmail.

facts.fact: The guide's authors say that in their experience Performance Max now often gives better results than their search campaigns.
facts.quote: now we often see better results running these than our search campaigns.

facts.fact: The guide describes Search Ads as text ads that appear at the top of Google search results.
facts.quote: Text ads that appear at the top of Google search results.
